text: Once you have a brute-force oracle for T(10^4)=41333, use spawn_candidates to explore at least three genuinely different implementations of the split-and-sum search in parallel (for example: recursive digit splitting with pruning, a digit-DP over carries, and a meet-in-the-middle over prefixes). Then read them back with attempt_diff and have the archivist adopt the one that agrees with the oracle and reaches 10^12.

Each candidate must reproduce T(10^4)=41333 against its own brute force before reporting. This is the priority task.
